title: Non‑Cooperation Movement Timeline
subject: History
caption: Timeline of the Non‑Cooperation Movement (1920‑1922)
altText: A chronological timeline starting with the launch on 4 September 1920, followed by the boycott of foreign goods, alignment with the Khilafat Movement, the 1921 Ahmedabad Congress session, promotion of Swadeshi enterprises, Gandhi's arrest in January 1922, the Chauri Chaura incident in February 1922, and the formal withdrawal of the movement later that year.
